links.outcome: Readability of LLM spine surgery answers under different plain-language prompting strategies
links.effect: Phase 2 (sixth-grade level request) gave the most readable responses, with 51.11% meeting the sixth-grade level. Follow-up clarification and simple prompts beat complex rule-based prompts.
links.quote: Phase 2 yielded the most readable responses, with 51.11% meeting the sixth-grade level.

unlisted_practices: Asking LLM follow-up clarification questions to improve readability

screen.practice: reading-level prompt constraints and follow-up questioning
screen.reason: The study directly tests different prompt engineering strategies and reading-level constraints (safeguards/deployment practices) on LLM-generated patient education materials to evaluate readability outcomes.
